content: {"question":"What is the purpose of the GitLab Offboarding Standards?","answer":"They specify requirements related to the offboarding of GitLab team members from all GitLab related computing resources and data assets to protect customers, team members, contractors, the company, and other partners from harm caused by both deliberate and inadvertent misuse.","evidence":"These standards specify requirements related to the offboarding of GitLab team members from all GitLab related computing resources and data assets so as to protect our customers, team members, contractors, company, and other partners from harm caused by both deliberate and inadvertent misuse."}
